# Update pre-written policies in a policy set

This topic shows how to update a policy set containing pre-written policies. If you want to create a policy set using pre-written policies refer to [Create new policy set](/terraform/cloud-docs/policy-enforcement/manage-policy-sets/pre-written#create-new-policy-set). 

## Update alert

When pre-written policies included in your policy sets receive an update you receive a notification:

- Via email, if configured.
- Via a global alert.
- On the **Policy sets** page.

The alert signals that one or more of the policies you use in your policy sets have an available update and provides you with a link or a button to navigate to the **Policy sets** page where the policy sets that have available updates are filtered.

You can retrieve the same information from the **Policy sets** page by using the filter in the top row of the policy sets table.

1. Click on the **Filters** dropdown.
1. On the **Version status** select the **Needs update** checkbox.

This will provide you a list of all policy sets containing policies that need update.

The policy update warning will remain in the interface, as a remainder, until you upgrade them even if you closed the alert banner.

## Update a policy set

You can update policies in a policy set either one by one or you can do a bulk upgrade.

### Update a single policy

If the policy set only contains one update-able policy or you want to update your policies one by one.

1. In the policy set details page navigate to the **Connected pre-written policies** section.
1. In the table, click on the `...` button for the policy you want to update.
1. In the dropdown click on **Review and update**. This will open a page showing you the diff between the two versions of the policy.
1. Review the diff and then click on the **Update to latest** button.
1. A message stating **Policy updated** with details over the policy name will appear on the bottom right part of the page.

### Bulk update policies

When the policy set contains multiple policies that can be updated you can update them all in a single operation.

1. In the policy set details page navigate to the **Connected pre-written policies** section.
1. Click on the **Filters** dropdown in the policies table.
1. On the **Version status** select the **Needs update** checkbox.
1. From the filtered results table, select all policies.
1. In the filter bar click on the **Actions** dropdown.
1. Click on **Review and update policies**. This will open a page showing all the policies that need review.
1. For each policy:
    1. In the table, click on the `...` button for the policy you want to update.
    1. Click on **Review policy code**. This will open a page showing you the diff between the two versions of the policy.
    1. Review the diff and then click on the **Back to review and update policies** button.
1. Once you reviewed all the policies, click on the **Update all to latest** button.
1. A message stating **All policies updated** with details over number of updated policies will appear on the bottom right part of the page.
